tasks.gr11-networks-internet-social-implicatio: Topic: Networks, internet and social implications. Cover LAN and WLAN, wired (Ethernet) and wireless (Wi-Fi) connections, network hardware (router, switch, hub, NIC), internet vs WWW, IP addresses, DNS, IoT, BYOD policies, digital citizenship, online privacy, and cyberbullying. Ask about network-component matching, connection-type comparisons, internet-terminology definitions, and digital-ethics scenarios.
tasks.gr11-websites-iot-security-privacy-t2: Topic: Websites, IoT, security and privacy. Cover website evaluation criteria, URL structure, HTTP vs HTTPS, phishing, identity theft, social engineering, cookies, cryptocurrency basics, big data concepts, POPIA compliance, and strong password strategies. Ask about website-trust evaluation, security-threat identification, online-risk scenarios, and privacy-law basics.
tasks.gr11-spreadsheets-if-logic-databases-t2: Topic: Spreadsheets IF logic and databases. Cover nested IF functions, logical operators (AND, OR, NOT), COUNTIF, SUMIF, VLOOKUP basics, data validation, conditional formatting, database queries (criteria rows, wildcard characters), sorting, filtering, and query design. Ask about IF formula construction, query-criteria writing, VLOOKUP scenarios, and spreadsheet logic items.
tasks.gr11-html-web-design-information-managem: Topic: HTML, web design and information management. Cover HTML document structure (DOCTYPE, html, head, body), common tags (h1-h6, p, a, img, table, ul, ol, li), attributes (href, src, alt), CSS basics (colour, font, margin), information quality (accuracy, currency, relevance, reliability), and referencing sources. Ask about HTML syntax fixes, tag-function matching, CSS property questions, and information-quality scenarios.
tasks.gr11-ai-big-data-t2: Topic: Artificial Intelligence and Big Data. Cover what AI is and its everyday uses, that it learns from data, big data (volume, variety, velocity, sources), how big data is used to train AI, and bias and privacy risks. Ask Grade 11 learners to define a term, link AI and big data, or name a risk.
tasks.gr11-cloud-storage-saas-adverts-t2: Topic: Cloud Storage, SaaS and Reading Adverts. Cover cloud storage as software as a service, its advantages and risks, choosing and protecting cloud storage, and interpreting adverts for hardware and cloud storage (specification, price, small print). Ask Grade 11 learners to compare two adverts or name an advantage and a risk.
